visibleTestCases.title: Initial Stream Open and Transition to wait_for_sasl
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin S0 = xmpp_c2s_fsm:init(<<"localhost">>), {reply, _, S1} = xmpp_c2s_fsm:handle_event({stream_open, <<"localhost">>}, S0), xmpp_c2s_fsm:get_state(S1) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Transitions from wait_for_stream to wait_for_sasl upon receiving stream_open.

visibleTestCases.title: Reject Chat Message Before Authentication
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin S0 = xmpp_c2s_fsm:init(<<"localhost">>), {reply, _, S1} = xmpp_c2s_fsm:handle_event({stream_open, <<"localhost">>}, S0), {error, Reason, _} = xmpp_c2s_fsm:handle_event({chat_message, <<"bob">>, <<"1">>, <<"hi">>}, S1), Reason end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Rejects chat messages in wait_for_sasl state with not_authorized.

visibleTestCases.title: Complete SASL Auth and Resource Binding
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin S0 = xmpp_c2s_fsm:init(<<"localhost">>), {reply, _, S1} = xmpp_c2s_fsm:handle_event({stream_open, <<"localhost">>}, S0), Token = base64:encode(<<0, "alice", 0, "secret">>), {reply, _, S2} = xmpp_c2s_fsm:handle_event({auth_plain, Token}, S1), {reply, _, S3} = xmpp_c2s_fsm:handle_event({bind_resource, <<"b1">>, <<"mobile">>}, S2), {xmpp_c2s_fsm:get_state(S3), maps:get(full_jid, S3)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Authenticates with SASL PLAIN, binds resource, and establishes Full JID session.
